name: CrossGen-Forensics
description: A deep learning forensic framework evaluating the generalization capability of AI-generated image detectors across GAN and Diffusion models (Stable Diffusion 2.1/3/XL, DALL-E 3, Midjourney v6). Benchmarks unseen-generator generalization, cross-generation transferability ( GAN ↔ Diffusion GAN↔Diffusion), and 6-class source generator attribution.
